name: Sleepover: reWake
source:
Kano is a simple guy living in a small town deep in the province. His best friend, Aki, was inseparable from him throughout the two’s childhood, but soon after left to attend college in the far-off city, and drifted apart from Kano.

One day out of nowhere, Aki texts Kano requesting to meetup, and through a twist of fate, the two are offered the opportunity to spend not only the full day, but also the night together – their last sleepover.

Help Kano navigate the two’s changed relationship, and create the special bond with Aki that he always wished they had. One night is all it takes!

[From the [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/sleepover/]official site[/url]]
